messages:
nate: Heads up — samplekit build failed regen check after yesterday's auth middleware refactor. Looks like generated types flipped and we accidentally bumped the SDK minor.
ci-bot: [ci] https://ci.internal.redwood/teams/devex/pipelines/4590/builds/9912 — regen check failed :x:
anya: can you paste the regendiff? may be the usual non-deterministic ordering but suspicious that naming changed too.
nate: paste below from regendiff:
```
-  "AuthenticationConfig": {
-    "use_default_retry": true,
-    "retry": {
-      "max": 5
-    }
-  }
+  "AuthenticationConfig": {
+    "retry": {
+      "max": 5
+    },
+    "useDefaultRetry": true
+  }
---
-  "x-redwood-meta": {
-    "author": "infra-service"
-  }
+  "x_redwood_meta": {
+    "author": "infra-service"
+  }
```
nate: so two things: property name case toggled in fixtures and properties reordered. The publish step detected a diff and bumped the sdk version to 1.3.0 -> 1.4.0 (minor).
kevin: the refactor pulled in infra's normalizeJson util; that converts keys to snake_case by default. We used it in a test fixture builder for the generator which is bad. Also typegen iteration didn't sort keys.
anya: agreed. short-term: remove normalizeJson from generator fixtures and add a deterministic key sort inside the typegen emitter. Also revert the accidental SDK minor bump in samplekit's package.json until we actually want a release.
kevin: I'll open PR with the revert + sort + test. Will add a small flaky-detection test that runs regen 5x and asserts identical output.
nate: for CI: can we gate the publish job so package changes that are only regendiff-based don't auto-increment? maybe require an OWNERS approval label?
ops-bot: suggestion: add job condition "only_publish_on_label: sdk-release" to publish workflow.
anya: yes, add manual gate. We shouldn't auto-publish on purely generated diffs.
kevin: PR 2501 opened: remove normalizeJson from fixtures, add deterministic sort, add regen-stability test.  (tags: @anya @nate)
ci-bot: PR 2501 checks queued: regen + unit tests + publish-gate check.
nate: temporary remediation: I've reverted package.json change in the samplekit repo and set env var SKIP_AUTOPUBLISH=true in the pipeline to block any accidental publishes until PR merges.
kevin: once PR lands I'll run scripts/regenerate.sh --all && commit the clean regen and we can re-enable the publish gate manually.
anya: also add a changelog entry: "fix(typegen): avoid normalizing fixture keys; ensure deterministic property sorting to prevent spurious regendiffs". Put it in CHANGELOG.next so release notes include it.
ops-bot: smoke test note — when regen lands, run smoke: https://smoke.internal.redwood/runs/5601 to validate runtime behavior.
ci-bot: re-run requested by nate — build 9913 queued.
nate: thanks everyone. will keep thread updated with PR/merge status.
